# mailer

Types from PocketBase's Go package `mailer`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [mailer](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/mailer).

## mailer.Message

Message defines a generic email message struct.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `from` | <code>{ address: string; name?: string; }</code> |  |
| `to` | <code>Array&lt;{ address: string; name?: string; }&gt;</code> |  |
| `bcc` | <code>Array&lt;{ address: string; name?: string; }&gt;</code> |  |
| `cc` | <code>Array&lt;{ address: string; name?: string; }&gt;</code> |  |
| `subject` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `html` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `text` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `headers` | <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> |  |
| `attachments` | <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> |  |
| `inlineAttachments` | <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> |  |

## mailer.Mailer

Mailer defines a base mail client interface.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `send()` | <code>(message: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/mailer#mailermessage">Message</a>): void</code> | Send sends an email with the provided Message. |
